about: The lessons (S16): data the lesson runner walks the learner through, attached to an NPC. Step types: explain, model, listen, repeat, answer, do, recap (see LessonBook for the fields of each). Every step has a skip and a help path; a failed or uncertain turn moves on after the step's attempts (fail-forward, D-game-9). Lines are pre-rendered speech ids (speech/<id>.wav); phrases are rows of content/PHRASES.md; a repeat or answer step's prompt must allow the phrase's intent. This file holds the two-step sample that ships with the runner; the guide's real lesson (S17) is more lessons here, with no code.

lessons.title: A first hello
lessons.english: Say hello to the guide, then say thank you. It takes a minute.

steps.english: Say hello to the guide. “Hola” is how you greet anyone.
steps.help: Say: Hola (OH-lah). It means hello. The letter h is silent in Spanish.
steps.retry: Not quite. Say: Hola. It means hello.

steps.english: The guide hands you something. Thank her.
steps.help: Say: Gracias (GRAH-see-ahs). It means thank you.
steps.retry: Not quite. Say: Gracias. It means thank you.
